newsitem.title: UK: Germany to tender to buy 500,000 tonnes jet, diesel.
newsitem.headline: Germany to tender to buy 500,000 tonnes jet, diesel.

text.p: Germany is set to tender to buy upwards of 500,000 tonnes of jet fuel and diesel, traders said on Friday.

The Erdoel Bevorrattungs Verband (EBV), a Hamburg-based government body regulating compulsory stock levels, is set to tender for 250,000 tonnes of jet and 250,000 tonnes of diesel on Monday or at the latest Tuesday, traders said.
"People will have the exact details on delivery dates and locations on their desks on Monday or Tuesday," said one trader.
Traders said the diesel would be for delivery during May and June, and the jet would be for delivery during May to September.
EBV was not available for comment, but traders quoting sources close to the agency said the tendering was driven by an increased demand for both products in 1996.
"They have had to revise their figures upwards because there was a lot of demand in 1996," said one.
The impact on the market could be significant, particularly in an already tight diesel market.
"We could move from being balanced to short, but we must wait and see," said one dealer.
